exposure: Induction of labor at 39 weeks of gestation for suspected fetal macrosomia (fetal weight >= 95th percentile)
No induction of labor (macrosomia diagnosed at birth)
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
Maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality
cohort: 256 patients who gave birth at a type 3 maternity hospital in France between 2016 and 2020, including those with suspected fetal macrosomia and those with macrosomia diagnosed at birth.
finding: While the induction of labor for suspected fetal macrosomia did not increase the rate of vaginal delivery, it significantly reduced the rate of neonatal acidosis.
